x: Card (T.V.H.) was a clear leader for 4 miles but faded badly enabling Pat, who had run a steady race, to gain just one more place and finish second in 30:10.2 - 18.6 seconds behind Major of Woodford.

Once again, Portsmouth AC, the team that has so often stood between us and major honours, were deserved Champions. By a remarkable coincidence they finished 5 in 37, exactly as in 1966, but this time their sixth man (Meadows) was 102nd against the previous year's 173rd.

With so many "major" fixtures in the Winter Calendar these days, and with the North Surrey League occupying a large part of the remaining space, the inter-club mob match is fast fading from its prominence of yesteryear.
Ealing & Southa ll won the team race from ourselves and Verlea, 46/64/80. Major, Donnison, Glover, Hilliar and Keavey were our other scorers.
Are we doomed to hover on the fringe eternally or can runners like Major, Bicourt, Piotrowski, Williams etc give us a lift up into the medals next year?.

Gilt edge Hart, Duquemin, Middleton, Major, Kerr and Martin continue as the backbone of our economy. Whilst high flyers Bent and Thresher continue to excite, Dull spots occurred with results from Hilton, C.

Yes, it was that demon of the track and country, the galloping MAJOR, doing the rounds in equal time at 45 r.p.m. The hall was strewn with paper chains and fairy lights and when the balloons went up, a lot of chains came down.
Others: Dear (72) Dance (77) Major (90) Hart (96) Dabbs (109) Bicourt (116) We won the Oddling Smee Cup for the first Surrey club to finish twelve runners.

Adrian Major did this to excellent effect in the "National". Those runners, past and present, who have considered themselves to be above reserve status would do well to heed the words of Arsenal's Terry Neil who is also captain of the Northern Ireland soccer team.
On his left is the link man Major the ex-minor who is making a name for himself in the big time. Then there is Scarlet O'Hara and Doug Brew - Doug Brew - I ask you!

Prospects for the coming major cross-country events are far from clear. There are always ifs and buts of course but will the loss of Diprose, the absence of Smith, the increased business pressure on Thresher and the moving house to Rochester of Geoff North have any serious effect?.

With the "National" won - Fairclough 273; Major 302; and Bicourt 392 will complete the first team for the "Nine Cup". Ted Stimpson comments, "If they only trained from the Hall, they would have had six in six".

It coincides with the running into form, just at the right time, of Kerr, Thresher, North, Major and Fairclough. With Bicourt and Hart already in fine fettle we could well be having a celebration dip in the Lido on September 12th.
